seq3-filas.titulo: Ten tasks, then go to sleep

inicio.titulo: From chat to agent: four steps to put AI to work for you
inicio.lead: Terminal, your own assistant, task queue, and social media on autopilot. In six short lessons, you’ll understand each step, see how the pieces fit together, and leave with the plan and templates to do things in the right order.
inicio.capa_alt: From chat to agent: the journey in four sequences — terminal, Jarvis, queues, and social media.

cursos.sub: Each step has a full course, with practice and a quiz. Go in order or jump straight to what you need right now.

itens.l: Open the terminal without fear, install the agent, set up the folder with rules, save every version with Git and put your page online.
An assistant with the memory and personality you define: four text files, a core built with tests and a chat over Telegram.

itens.t: Queues: ten tasks and go to sleep
itens.l: Send ten tasks, go to sleep and check in the morning: what goes into the queue, the inemaccbot and the gates before what matters.
A reel in 7 stages, videos for each audience and the channel for your niche that checks every number and only publishes what you approved.

inicio.aulas_sub: An overview of each step. Each step has a full course, linked at the end of its lesson.

itens: People who use ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and want to stop copying and pasting.
Professionals who want their own assistant and tasks running without constant supervision.
People who will guide teams or clients through this transition and need the full roadmap.

blocos.t: What you’ll be able to do
itens: Say which step you’re on and what comes next.
Set up the agent’s folder with AGENTS.md, Git, and secrets kept out of the text.
Design your assistant, your queue with gates, and your niche’s channel with the source on screen.
Follow a four-week plan with 23 verifiable exercises.
